class.name: CubismEffect
class.brief_description: A custom parameter effect evaluated in the preferred model pipeline.
class.description: Place directly under a [CubismModel2D] and connect [signal effect_process]. Enabled effects run after lip sync and legacy custom processing, before EFFECT-layer writes and physics. Lower priorities run first; equal priorities use case-sensitive node-name order. Give procedurally created siblings explicit stable names when their priorities tie. Membership, names, priorities and enabled flags are captured at the start of each model update. Changes affect the next update. Removed, reparented, queued-for-deletion or process-disabled effects are skipped before their callback. Model pause and speed govern the callback clock. There is no independent _process clock. This node's parameter methods write immediately only during its own synchronous callback. They return ERR_UNAVAILABLE otherwise, including after an await, reparent, model reload/unload or queued deletion. The model's own parameter methods still queue writes for the next step. Later effects, layers, physics or pose may replace an effect's result. Existing [GDCubismEffectCustom] lifecycle signals retain their legacy behavior under [GDCubismUserModel].

method.name: set_parameter_value
method.description: During this effect's callback, blend current*(1-weight)+value*weight. Requires finite values and weight in [0,1]. Unknown IDs return ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST; invalid values return ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER. Results are clamped to the native parameter range.

method.name: add_parameter_value
method.description: Blend current+value*weight using the same callback scope and validation as set_parameter_value.

method.name: multiply_parameter_value
method.description: Blend current*(1+(value-1)*weight) using the same callback scope and validation as set_parameter_value.

signal.name: effect_process
signal.description: Synchronous custom-effect stage. Read the model's current stage values and write through this effect. Do not await inside the callback; write access expires when it returns. Use queue_free for removal from callbacks.

members.member: Whether to include this effect in the next model step.
Lower values run first. Ties use node names, not sibling insertion order.
